register.name: Name

register.passwordInvalid: The password must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and 6 characters.

validation._comentario: Mensajes generales para cualquier formulario. Cada clave se llama igual que el error de los Validators de Angular (required, email, minlength...). {{min}} y {{max}} se reemplazan con el límite del campo.
validation.minlength: Must be at least {{min}} characters long.
validation._comentarioLogin: Mensajes específicos del inicio de sesión. Las reglas de la contraseña (8 a 72 caracteres) son las definidas para bcrypt.
validation.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters long.

errors._comentario: Mensajes según la respuesta HTTP del backend. 'network' se usa cuando no hay respuesta del servidor y 'unknown' para cualquier otro error.
errors.unauthorized: You are not authorized or your session has expired.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.notFound: The requested resource was not found.
errors.conflict: The operation conflicts with existing data.
errors.network: Could not connect to the server. Check your connection.

messages.confirmLogout: Are you sure you want to log out?
messages.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this record? This action cannot be undone.
messages.changesDiscarded: Do you want to discard the changes made?
messages.operationFailed: The operation could not be completed.
messages.networkError: Could not connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
